name: Neural Network Model for Participating Media Scattering
definition: A method for interactive simulation of scattering effects in participating media using a neural network model to evaluate multiple and double scattering, combined with a single scattering approximation.
summary: This method simulates participating media scattering using a neural network for multiple scattering and a single scattering approximation, storing the entire parameter space in kilobytes to avoid artifacts and large memory usage.
